### GT save function

```{r save-func, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# save function
gt_save_crop <- function(
  data,
  file = NULL,
  bg = "white",
  whitespace = 50,
  zoom = 2,
  expand = 5
) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch(
    {
      gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
      message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
      gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
    }
  )

  magick::image_read(tmp) |>
    magick::image_trim() |>
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |>
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}


library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)
library(gtUtils)
```

### GT Table with poll

```{r gt-poll, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

poll_path <- "ap_preseason_poll_2026.csv"
png_output_path <- "ap_preseason_points_grid_2026.png"

logo_lookup <- cbbdata::cbd_teams() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    team = dplyr::recode(espn_location, "Appalachian State" = "App State"),
    logo = espn_logo
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(team), !is.na(logo)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(team, .keep_all = TRUE)

ap_points <- readr::read_csv(poll_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

ballots <- sum(ap_points$first_place_votes, na.rm = TRUE)
possible_points <- ballots * 25

ap_points <- ap_points |>
  dplyr::left_join(logo_lookup, by = "team") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent_possible = votes / possible_points,
    grid_row = ceiling(vote_order / 5),
    grid_column = paste0("column_", rep(1:5, length.out = dplyr::n())),
    rank_label = dplyr::if_else(
      status == "Top 25",
      paste0("#", rank),
      "RV"
    ),
    logo_style = dplyr::if_else(
      status == "Top 25",
      "",
      "filter: grayscale(100%); opacity: 0.42;"
    ),
    tile = paste0(
      "<div style='min-height:112px; text-align:center; padding:8px 4px;'>",
      "<div style='font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:#555;'>",
      rank_label,
      "</div>",
      "<img src='",
      logo,
      "' alt='",
      team,
      " logo' style='height:46px; max-width:70px; object-fit:contain; ",
      logo_style,
      "'>",
      "<div style='font-size:13px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15;'>",
      team,
      "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:20px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.2;'>",
      scales::percent(percent_possible, accuracy = 0.1),
      "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:10px; color:#777;'>",
      scales::comma(votes),
      dplyr::if_else(votes == 1, " point</div>", " points</div>"),
      "</div>"
    )
  )

missing_logos <- ap_points |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(logo)) |>
  dplyr::pull(team)

if (length(missing_logos) > 0) {
  stop("Missing logos for: ", paste(missing_logos, collapse = ", "))
}

fball_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>2026 AP Preseason Poll: Share of Possible Points</span>
       <span style='font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>Each percentage is the team's points divided by <b>1,725 possible points (69 ballots x 25)</b>.<br> Teams receiving-votes are shown in gray.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://assets.apnews.com/19/66/bc546486408c8595f01753a9fbeb/ap-logo-176-by-208.svg '
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)

points_grid <- ap_points |>
  dplyr::select(grid_row, grid_column, tile) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = grid_column,
    values_from = tile
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(grid_row) |>
  dplyr::select(-grid_row) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_almanac(
    accent = "#FF322E",
  density = "social",
  stripe = NA,
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = dplyr::everything()) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    column_1 = "",
    column_2 = "",
    column_3 = "",
    column_4 = "",
    column_5 = ""
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = dplyr::everything()
  ) |>
  gt::cols_width(dplyr::everything() ~ gt::px(150)) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(fball_header)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(
    "<hr>data via apnews.com and bakonyalgo.com/ap
     <br><hr>
     Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  )) |> 
  gt::tab_options(
    column_labels.hidden = TRUE,
    table.width = gt::px(750),
    table.background.color = "white",
    heading.align = "center",
    heading.title.font.size = gt::px(24),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = gt::px(13),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(0),
    table_body.hlines.color = "#dddddd",
    table_body.vlines.color = "#dddddd",
    source_notes.font.size = gt::px(11)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#f3f3f3"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "#555555")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = 6:10)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      color = "#555555",
      weight = gt::px(3)
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = 6)
  )

gt::gtsave(points_grid, png_output_path, zoom = 2)

points_grid
```
